title: IN → THROUGH → OUT → BACK — main take, sub-takes. what can clear today.

the_fold.in: looked at self. Proton live. BearDog named. vesicles locked.
the_fold.through: ORCID pair public. dock sort published. neutrino can measure the beacon path.
the_fold.out: GitHub clothes have a face. feed has the plaques.
the_fold.back: public ORCID pull confirmed. sit. do not open a new kingdom tonight.

main_take.plain: The day closes on the hard dock that already landed. Do not mix keys. Do not start Stalwart. Do not force vesicles. Tomorrow morning is one look.

sub_takes.why: Proton is already through. CF routing is a click in your dashboard when you want mail to land. That is not tonight.
the noun and the print are through. one-seed mix is a later firm job. opening it tonight invents a fourth core.
reminder is already Oct 25 morning. SSH console is you. agent cannot turn it.

cleared_today: both works on ORCID, public, pulled back
cores named as three, not twenty
aim: clear TODAY means close the pile, not finish mail and crypto. the three sub-takes stay on the dock they belong to.
